dimensions.detail: An unpaid request is answered with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge carrying scheme, network, asset and amount.
A replayed payment is refused without settling a second time.
An unreachable or erroring facilitator withholds the resource rather than serving it free.
A paid request beyond the concurrency cap is refused with a retry indication rather than queued indefinitely.
No paid settlement was performed to produce this document. Payment-path behaviour beyond the unpaid challenge is unverified here.
The published declaration digest is reproducible from the offer catalog fields it covers.
The published resource description stays within the facilitator's undocumented length ceiling that previously caused every settlement to be refused.
Whether any third-party registry currently indexes this offer is not asserted by this document.

limitations: Protocol conformance and discovery eligibility are reported separately and must not be combined into a single score.
Dimensions marked not-observed were not measured for this document; they are neither passing nor failing.
Local contract tests are deterministic and reproducible, but they exercise Maha's implementation, not a deployed third-party facilitator.
This is Maha's own evidence about Maha. It is not an independent audit and not a trust score.
No credential, payment signature, request content, response body, raw header or customer data appears in this document.
